description: Implementation of a stub audio decoder for testing or placeholder purposes within the starboard media framework, including methods for decoding, resetting, and handling end-of-stream scenarios.

classes.name: StubAudioDecoder
classes.description: A placeholder audio decoder class that simulates decoding operations for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetSupportedSampleType
methods.description: Determines the supported audio sample type, preferring float32 if supported, otherwise int16.

methods.name: CalculateFramesPerInputBuffer
methods.description: Calculates the number of frames per input buffer based on timestamps of two consecutive input buffers.

methods.name: CreateDecodedAudio
methods.description: Creates a DecodedAudio object filled with dummy data for testing.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with output and error callbacks.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::Decode
methods.description: Schedules decoding of input buffers on a separate thread.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles end-of-stream scenario by pushing an empty DecodedAudio.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::Read
methods.description: Reads decoded audio data, returning the next available DecodedAudio object.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state, clearing buffers and stopping the decoding thread.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::DecodeBuffers
methods.description: Processes each input buffer to produce decoded audio.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::DecodeOneBuffer
methods.description: Decodes a single input buffer into a dummy DecodedAudio object.

methods.name: StubAudioDecoder::DecodeEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles the end-of-stream decoding process, generating final decoded audio.
